headline: Latest-benchmark reference only; not live opening quotes. Each figure carries its own effective date.
nigeria_note: CBN benchmark rates are those of 14 Oct (15 Oct not yet posted; the 14 Oct NFEM average reflects interbank deals only). Nigeria parallel-market ranges are not published in this Early Look because fewer than two independent current observations could be verified.
markets_note: Latest official reference values with effective dates: Ghana mid of Bank of Ghana buy/sell (14 Oct); Kenya CBK commercial-banks’ average closing rates (market close 13 Oct; not a standalone buy or sell quote); South Africa SARB weighted-average bank rates at approximately 10:30 on 14 Oct (carried forward; SARB endpoint unreachable this morning); Egypt mid of CBE buy/sell (14 Oct).
nigeria_market_note_short: Parallel ranges not published: insufficient independent current observations.
